北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾霾，外出记得戴口罩，体感 14℃ 偏凉，注意保暖。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Beijing. Remember to wear a mask and dress warmly, it feels cooler at 14℃.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 17℃ 略凉，出门记得添件外套，保持舒适。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Cixi. It feels a bit cool at 17℃, remember to wear a jacket and stay comfy.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 18℃ 舒适，风力微弱，出门逛逛记得带伞备用。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shanghai, 18℃ feels comfy. Gentle breeze, carry an umbrella just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 28℃ 闷热，湿度高，记得多喝水，小心暑热。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou, feels muggy at 28℃. High humidity, remember to drink water and avoid heatstroke.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 20℃，湿度 80% 较高，出门带伞，谨防湿热。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenzhen, 20℃ feels comfortable. High humidity, bring an umbrella and stay dry.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 18℃ 略凉，出门穿件薄外套，保持温暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Hangzhou, feels slightly cool at 18℃. Wear a light jacket to stay warm.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 15℃ 较凉，风力 3级，记得多穿衣服防风。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing, feels chilly at 15℃ with a moderate wind. Dress warmly to stay protected.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 17℃ 略凉，湿度较高，外出小心湿冷，带伞。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, feels cool at 17℃. High humidity, beware of damp cold, bring an umbrella.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 17℃ 微凉，湿度较高，出门注意保持身体舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Wuhan, feels slightly cool at 17℃. High humidity, remember to stay comfortable when heading out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 20℃ 舒适宜人，微风拂面，心情也美美哒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, 20℃ feels pleasant. A gentle breeze, perfect for a lovely day out.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾弥漫，能见度低，出门请注意交通安全，小心慢行。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Chongqing, visibility is low. Please be extra careful and drive slowly if you're out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾，体感 5℃ 伴 4级 风，请务必多穿厚衣物保暖防风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Harbin, feels like 5℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly to protect from the cold and wind.
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感只有 6℃，风力 3级。阳光虽好，也要多穿衣物保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Shenyang, but it feels like only 6℃ with moderate winds. Enjoy the sun, but dress warmly!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 19℃ 略凉，风力 3级，出门记得穿件薄外套。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels a bit cool at 19℃ with moderate wind. Remember to wear a light jacket.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雨，体感 19℃，湿度 84% 较大，出门务必带伞，谨防湿滑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Raining in Xiamen, feels like 19℃ with high humidity. Be sure to bring an umbrella and watch out for slippery surfaces.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 6℃ 伴 3级 风，能见度低，出门务必注意安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Qingdao, feels like 6℃ with moderate winds. Low visibility, please stay safe when heading out.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 5℃ 伴 3级 风，天气较冷，出门请务必多穿。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels like 5℃ with moderate winds. It's quite cold, please dress very warmly.
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
